subject: a small weathered stone roadside shrine seen close and from slightly below, its mossy tiled roof and sagging cord crowded with knotted paper fortunes and wooden votive plaques hanging thickly from the eaves, a crowded row of tiny stone jizo figures crammed along its ledge with cracked faces and chipped-off hands worn past expression, dark red cloth bibs on the figures, pale paper streamers pinned under the eaves, spider lilies among them, the roof and its hangings filling the upper part of the frame, the posts and ledge falling away into darkness below
